title: 第3章 冥河 人死鸟朝天不死万万年本老祖干了第4章 镇元子 师侄你这是何必呢
slug: 从车迟国开始布局西游
lines: 牛魔王连忙躬身，额头渗出细汗：“师兄教训得是！是师弟目光短浅了！道不轻传，理应如此，理应如此！”
江辰端坐主位，淡淡道：“既然如此还不速速闯阵?”
牛魔王转头看向红孩儿:“我儿，这可是天大的机缘，快去闯阵去吧。”
红孩儿虽说不愿，但是父命难违，也只好转身进了阵法。
江辰见红孩儿进了大阵，端起茶水又喝了一口:“师弟，我观你修为不过大罗金仙一重圆满，若是我没记错，封神量劫时你便已是大罗金仙一重了，怎么进境如此缓慢?”
“师兄明鉴，老牛我日日苦修不曾有一丝懈怠，却是不知为何修为却不得寸进。”
“嗯?竟有此事？”
“俺老牛句句属实，不敢欺骗二师兄半句！”
听着牛魔王的话，江辰也意识到了不对劲，要知道，牛魔王的资质可不算差，自封神量劫过后到如今也有八百多年了，在翠云山这样的洞天之中修炼八百年却连小境界都未突破这非常的不合理。
于是江辰将牛魔王从头到脚探查了一遍，最终发现牛魔王的神魂少了一角。
江辰皱了皱眉:“师弟，你的神魂为何缺了一角?你竟一点都未察觉吗？”
牛魔王满脸茫然：“神魂缺了一角？师兄，俺老牛真不知道啊！”
“我只当是我资质愚钝、大道难修，从没想过是神魂出了问题，不过师兄若是神魂真缺了一角，我怎么可能毫无知觉？”
“取走你神魂的手段非常高明，你连准圣都不是，察觉不到也很正常。”
牛魔王见江辰一语道破了自己神魂的缺陷，连忙跪倒在地:“还请师兄救救俺老牛！俺可不想一辈子被困在大罗金仙一重。”
“你身后有圣人算计，师兄我确实是可以让你恢复，不过我还在布局西游，你且忍耐一段时间。”
说话间铁扇公主回来了:“师兄，我已联系了老祖，老祖让您去血海一叙。”
“且等等吧，看你这儿子是否与我有师徒之缘。”
“是，师兄。”
转眼半月过去了，就在第十天傍晚红孩儿闯出了问心阵，接着红孩儿又花了三天时间闯过了幻阵。
江辰点了点头，虽说以红孩儿的资质闯阵时间久了点，但是也达到了自己的预期，倒也算的上有师徒之缘。
牛魔王开心不已:“我儿，还不速速拜见你的师傅?”
红孩儿现在也知道了江辰的厉害，随手摆下的大阵就困了自己这么多天，能拜这样的粗大腿为师那简直就是天大的福分!
红孩儿恭敬的跪倒在地:“徒儿红孩儿见过师尊!”
“好，从今天起你就是我江辰的内门弟子了，以后你便随我修行吧。”
“是，师傅。”
江辰想了想，自己在芭蕉洞外毁了红孩儿的法宝，现在红孩儿成了自己的徒弟，怎么着也得表示表示。
于是拿出一杆长枪:“此宝名为神威烈火枪，为下品先天灵宝，枪长九尺九寸乃是开天辟地之初，一缕未散的混沌火精与一颗陨落的星辰残骸融合而成。”
“持枪者注入灵力，枪身火纹可化为混沌火蛇缠绕敌手，封其退路，也可化作火盾用来防守，可攻可防，倒也算得上是下品先天灵宝中的翘楚，今日便赐你了。”
“谢师尊赐宝!”
“好了，起来吧，咱们走一趟血海。”
content_en:
The Bull Demon King quickly bowed, sweat dripping from his forehead: "Senior brother, you taught me the lesson! It's my junior brother who is short-sighted! The truth should not be preached lightly, as it should be, as it should be!"
Jiang Chen sat on the main seat and said calmly: "In this case, why don't you rush into the formation quickly?"
The Bull Demon King turned to look at Red Boy: "My son, this is a great opportunity, go and break into the formation."
Although Red Boy said he didn't want to, he couldn't disobey his father's orders, so he had no choice but to turn around and enter the formation.
Seeing Red Boy enter the formation, Jiang Chen picked up the tea and took another sip: "Junior brother, I think your cultivation is not at the first level of Daluo Golden Immortal. If I remember correctly, you were already at the first level of Daluo Golden Immortal when you were conferred upon the gods to measure the calamity. Why is your progress so slow?"
"Senior Brother Mingjian, Lao Niu, I have been practicing hard every day without slacking off, but I don't know why I can't make any progress."
"Huh? Is this happening?"
"Every word I say is true, I dare not deceive my second senior brother!"
Listening to the words of the Bull Demon King, Jiang Chen also realized that something was wrong. You must know that the Bull Demon King's qualifications are not bad. It has been more than 800 years since he proclaimed himself a god. It is very unreasonable to practice in a cave like Cuiyun Mountain for 800 years without even breaking through a small realm.
So Jiang Chen inspected the Bull Demon King from head to toe, and finally found that a corner of the Bull Demon King's soul was missing.
Jiang Chen frowned: "Junior brother, why is a corner of your soul missing? Didn't you notice at all?"
The Bull Demon King looked confused: "Is there a corner of the soul missing? Senior brother, I really don't know!"
"I just thought that my qualifications were dull and it was difficult for me to cultivate the Dao. I never thought that there was something wrong with my soul. But if senior brother, there is really a piece of the soul missing, how could I be unconscious?"
"The method of taking away your soul is very clever. You are not even a quasi-sage, so it is normal for you not to notice it."
When the Bull Demon King saw Jiang Chen's words revealing the flaws of his soul, he quickly knelt down on the ground: "Senior Brother, please save me, Old Niu! I don't want to be trapped in the first level of Daluo Golden Immortal for the rest of my life."
"There is a sage plotting behind you. Senior brother, I can indeed help you recover, but I am still planning my journey to the west. Please be patient for a while."
While talking, Princess Iron Fan came back: "Senior brother, I have contacted the ancestor, and the ancestor asked you to go to the sea of ​​blood to talk about it."
"Let's wait and see if your son has a master-disciple relationship with me."
"Yes, senior brother."
…
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye, and on the evening of the tenth day, Honghaier broke out of the Questioning Heart Formation, and then it took Honghaier another three days to break through the Illusionary Formation.
Jiang Chen nodded. Although it took a long time to enter the battlefield with Red Boy's qualifications, it has met his expectations. It can be regarded as a master-disciple relationship.
The Bull Demon King was very happy: "My son, why don't you quickly meet your master?"
Hong Hai'er now also knows how powerful Jiang Chen is. The large formation he set up casually has trapped him for so many days. It is a great blessing to have such a thick thigh as his teacher!
Hong Hai'er knelt down respectfully: "Disciple Hong Hai'er has met Master!"
"Okay, from today on, you are my inner disciple, Jiang Chen. From now on, you can practice with me."
"Yes, master."
Jiang Chen thought for a while, he destroyed Hong Haier's magic weapon outside the Bajiao Cave, and now that Hong Haier has become his apprentice, he has to express his feelings no matter what.
So he took out a long spear: "This treasure is called the Divine Power Fiery Spear. It is a low-grade innate spiritual treasure. The spear is nine feet and nine inches long. It was made from the fusion of a wisp of chaotic fire essence and the remains of a fallen star at the beginning of the world."
"The wielder of the gun injects spiritual power. The fire pattern on the gun body can turn into a chaotic fire snake to wrap around the opponent and block his retreat. It can also be turned into a fire shield for defense. It can be used both offensively and defensively. It can be considered a leader among low-grade innate spiritual treasures. I will give it to you today."
"Thank you Master for the treasure!"
"Okay, get up, let's take a trip to the sea of blood."
